text: Evening. I'm minding my grandson Alfie tonight, he's 3. About twenty minutes ago he had what I think was a fit. He went stiff all over, then his arms and legs were shaking and his eyes rolled up. Never seen him do anything like it before, and as far as I know it's the first time. Temperature was 38.2 when I took it just after. I've had a good look for any rash and can't find one at all, and I did the glass test on a couple of marks on his legs and they went pale, so I don't think it's that. Not sure if I should be ringing an ambulance or if you'd want to speak to me first. His mum's on her way back.
